cd /var/openhands/conversations/7a0f58a298fa4500b9e92a3caa285d94/events && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, glob, re
files = sorted(glob.glob('event-*.json'))
pat = re.compile(r'cloudflare|cloude?frame|sinaja|ddos-guard|captchaai|turnstile|vps|solver|flaresolverr|browserless|ssh', re.I)
for f in files:
    j=json.load(open(f))
    if j.get('kind')!='MessageEvent': continue
    if j.get('llm_message',{}).get('role')!='assistant': continue
    c=j['llm_message'].get('content')
    t=''
    if isinstance(c,list):
        for p in c:
            if isinstance(p,dict) and p.get('type')=='text': t+=p.get('text','')
    if pat.search(t):
        m=[x for x in pat.finditer(t)]
        print('===',j['timestamp'])
        for x in m[:4]:
            s=max(0,x.start()-200); e=min(len(t),x.end()+300)
            print('   ...',t[s:e].replace('\n',' '),'...')
        print()
EOF
